news.text: JOHN: CONFIDENCE IN #SPALLETTIA strong signal arrives from #Juve's ownership.#Elkann from the USA clears the bianconero landscape of the #Conte misunderstanding: moving forward with Lucio, convinced that the coach and the team will know how to reverse the course. Sabatini: "Lucio is still the right man, but this is the most difficult mission of his life. He must use simplicity to bring the players closer to his ideals of perfection". Tomorrow against #Rennes here is again #Kolo-#Woltemade, #Çelik returns to the right.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇮🇹⁉️ #Juventus is targeting #Raimondo, but #Frosinone has no intention of letting him go in January. The bianconeri could try to beat the competition in the winter, but even #Bologna - the club that owns his contract - might also prefer to postpone everything until the summer. If he continues like this, his price tag could increase, also attracting interest from foreign clubs.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙💪 #Spalletti wants to reanimate #Juventus: he spoke out, demanding a different mentality and attitude. They are starting fresh with a tactical revision: three at the back. The 4-2-3-1 is weakened by the absence of a center-forward capable of leading the line on his own. However, the signals must come primarily from the attitude. The coach reiterated his full confidence to the squad: everyone has always worked with the utmost seriousness and commitment.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 #Juventus is going through a phase of deep difficulty, but confirms its trust in Luciano #Spalletti and is not concretely evaluating any alternatives.The criticisms directed at the coach are considered excessive.The immediate priority is to reunite the environment, overcome internal tensions and regain serenity and results.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

👀 Gleison #Bremer apologized to Luciano #Spalletti and his #Juventus teammates upon returning to training.The Brazilian defender admitted that he let himself be carried away by the anger of the moment, following his declarations to Sky Sport in the post-game after the #Lazio match.#Spalletti reaffirmed his line of firmness in front of the group and demanded individual self-criticism first.The outburst from the defender, who wears the captain's armband in the absence of Manuel #Locatelli, did not please the management at all.#Bremer will receive a fine, which he has already accepted.Guglielmo #Vicario, on the other hand, called for responsibility: "We have to stay focused on the history of th

👀 Luciano #Spalletti would be evaluating whether to commit with greater continuity to a 3-man defense at #Juventus.The 3-4-2-1 formation could be the starting point to rebuild some certainties, especially during a phase in which the team seems to suffer when losing possession.The tactical choice would allow defensive responsibilities to be distributed differently and make better use of the wing-backs' work.The club would have chosen to maintain confidence in the coach, giving him a decisive period to prove he can turn the situation around.Before the next international break, the bianconeri will play six matches, starting with #Rennes this Thursday in the Europa League.[@tuttosport via @TUTTO

⚠️ Repubblica reveals: in the event of a mid-season replacement, the caretaker manager for #Juventus could be #Pioli and not #Conte with the club then negotiating with #Inzaghi or #Farioli for the following season.The ex captain could only come back into the picture if things were to collapse in a thunderous manner and pressure from the fans push #Elkann to impose him upon the club's top management.[Giovanni Capuano]

🇮🇹👀 "#Juventus is evaluating the signing of a striker, possibly as early as January or more likely in the summer, with the aim of rejuvenating the squad and make it more Italian. Among the profiles being followed is #Raimondo: under contract with #Bologna until 2028 with an option, he has already ended up in the bianconero crosshairs, and they are closely monitoring his growth. The excellent relations between the clubs could favor a potential negotiation."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐❗️#Juventus has decided to confirm #Spalletti, at least for now: the club believes he still has control of the locker room, but expects concrete signs of a recovery, otherwise the situation could change. The coach is convinced he can revitalize the team and bring them back to the levels shown before the slump. Furthermore, a meeting with #Bremer is planned to clarify the tensions that have emerged.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🚨 Excl. - Yesterday, in addition to Ricky #Massara, sporting director Marco #Ottolini was also at the Moccagatta for #Juve #NextGen-#Renate. In addition to observing the young bianconeri talents, the objective of the #Juventus management duo was the 2008-born gem of #Renate, Filippo #Viganò, but the left-footed center-back ultimately didn't play. #Juve, much like #Atalanta (that already wanted him in July) and #Sassuolo, has in fact been keeping him under observation for a long time. #calciomercato[Nico Schira]

ℹ️🇪🇺 Referee appointments for #JuveRennes:- Referee: Morten Krogh 🇩🇰- Assistant referees: Victor Skytte 🇩🇰 – Steffen Bramsen 🇩🇰- Fourth official: Jacob Karlsen 🇩🇰- VAR: Benjamin Brand 🇩🇪- AVAR: Stuart Attwell [Juventus Reborn on X]

#Juventus will do everything they can - results permitting - to avoid changing managers until the end of the season. After that, regardless of where they finish, it appears highly unlikely that #Spalletti will stay beyond June 30. Antonio #Conte remains the dream of many fans, but keep an eye on Simone #Inzaghi as well.[Mirko Nicolino]

#SPALLETTI ON THE BRINKThe coach has lost #Juve: time-bound trust.Disastrous start, no more chances left. The nervous coach demands a clarification from #Bremer. The fans call for #Conte (who knows how to take over mid-season).[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

LUCIO AND SHADOWS#Bremer apologizesThe flop against #Lazio, the rumors about #Conte and the harsh criticisms from the Brazilian.#Juve is with #Spalletti, but answers are needed.Delicate moment: the club acts as a shield. Confrontation between the coach and the squad at la Continassa. The captain was also called out: "We all lost, no one is excluded". #Rennes on Thursday. #Comolli goes to B: president of #Pisa.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#SPALLETTI MANDATORY TRUST#Juve has too many reasons to move forward with Lucio who challenges the ghost of #Conte and covers himself with a 3-man defense.Fans are furious with the coach, the team and the club, which in the meantime has fined #Bremer following his apology to his teammates. Until the international break, there are 6 matches to turn things around, starting with #Rennes this Thursday in the Europa League. But #Conceição is KO as well: dislocated shoulder.[Front Page TuttoSport]

👨‍🦲🆙 "#Spalletti: the trust continues, but a change of pace is absolutely expected. The results, the performances and the quality of play are not up to #Juventus standard. To date, zero imminent updates regarding a change: the situation should be monitored, but, for now, the club chooses to wait and hope for a turnaround. The club is also internally handling the locker room balance, a crucial aspect to understand what will happen next."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
